To her left of it, a horizontal transition zone crosses about 66% of the way down her figure from the top; to her right of it, a different horizontal transition zone crosses about 31% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is the upper area to her left of the vertical zone, above the left horizontal zone: it carries polished obsidian stone fused directly to her own form, solid glossy black stone curving to follow her body's true shape, with molten gold seams running between fitted stone sections. Region 4 is the lower area to her right of the vertical zone, below the right horizontal zone: it carries UV-reactive neon bodypaint, invisible under standard light but supernova burst formations in ELECTRIC GOLD and MAGENTA glowing at full intensity under her own dedicated UV blacklight. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even course, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Face: a real photograph of a real Korean woman's face, not an illustration and not a CG render — visible pores and fine skin grain, the fine natural expression lines of her age around the eyes and mouth, faint peach-fuzz hairs catching the light, natural tonal variation with a soft flush on the cheeks, a few small natural beauty marks, slight natural asymmetry, eyes with real wet catchlights and individual lashes, lips with real vertical texture — never airbrushed, never smooth like plastic. Pose: standing full height, both arms slightly spread commanding the frame, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme curvy petite silhouette ever displayed. A standard hard key light illuminates most of her body; a separate dedicated UV blacklight illuminates the UV-reactive region specifically, making it glow at full intensity while the rest reads under normal light.
extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.
